headerHint: Which AI tool reads which instruction file: read-only detection, nothing is rewritten

drift.missing-agents-import: CLAUDE.md does not import @AGENTS.md: Claude Code and AGENTS.md readers see different instructions
drift.broken-agents-import: CLAUDE.md imports @AGENTS.md but AGENTS.md is missing
drift.agents-md-over-codex-cap: AGENTS.md exceeds the Codex 32 KiB project-doc cap
drift.skill-copy-diverged: Duplicated skill copies diverged between .claude/skills and .agents/skills
drift.skill-copy-file-missing: A skill file exists in only one of the duplicated skill trees
drift.agent-copy-diverged: Duplicated agent briefs diverged between .claude/agents and .agents/agents
drift.agent-copy-file-missing: An agent brief exists in only one of the duplicated trees
drift.non-english-agent-text: An agent file carries non-English text, and its text is what a blocked or steered agent reads
drift.mcp-config-unparseable: An agent-connection (MCP) config file exists but declares no server, so every grant beside it is undeclared
drift.undeclared-mcp-server: An agent brief grants tools from an MCP server its config does not declare
